step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture is Sanofi's Darwin Real World Evidence (RWE) platform, built on AWS. It allows data scientists to securely deploy isolated environments and process clinical data. The user interaction begins with authentication. Users access a static website hosted in S3 and served via CloudFront. Authentication is federated using Amazon Cognito and Sanofi's internal SSO. From there, users can provision dedicated analytics environments like SageMaker or RStudio using AWS Service Catalog. Activity and user metadata are audited and tracked via API Gateway and written to DynamoDB. Heavy machine learning and NLP workloads, such as clinical document translation and entity recognition, are orchestrated by Lambda using Amazon Translate and Amazon Comprehend Medical. The processed assets and source databases remain highly segregated and secure in a centralized S3 Data Lake.

nodes.name: Users
nodes.notes: Data scientists and analysts accessing the analytics workspace portal.

nodes.name: CLOUDFRONT
nodes.notes: Edge distribution serving the web portal with integrated SSL certificates.

nodes.name: SANOFI SSO
nodes.notes: External Identity Provider (IdP) for federated enterprise login.

nodes.name: COGNITO
nodes.notes: Handles identity federation and issues secure tokens to users.

nodes.name: S3 Static Website
nodes.notes: Hosts the frontend static assets of the self-service web portal.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Exposes REST endpoints for portal activity and triggers processing services.

nodes.name: DYNAMO DB
nodes.notes: Stores user metadata and platform audit logs to maintain a strict trace of user actions.

nodes.name: SERVICE CATALOG
nodes.notes: Provisions CloudFormation-based data science environments in an isolated, secure template fashion.

nodes.name: R STUDIO
nodes.notes: Analytical IDE provisioned via Service Catalog for smart dataset evaluation.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Machine learning notebook instances with customized storage (e.g., 100 GB volumes).

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Serverless functions executing SDK logic for mass translation and medical entity recognition.

nodes.name: TRANSLATE
nodes.notes: Converts clinical raw files into target analysis languages.

nodes.name: COMPREHEND MEDICAL
nodes.notes: Identifies critical medical metadata and PHI inside raw datasets.

nodes.name: DATA LAKE
nodes.notes: Secure centralized clinical data lake with strict access control; data never leaves this perimeter.

edges.notes: CloudFront serves the web portal files from the S3 bucket.

SSO returns assertion and redirects back.

Launches R Studio server instance dynamically.
R Studio accesses workspace data directly inside the S3 Data Lake.
SageMaker loads and processes clinical data securely from S3.
Portal interacts with API Gateway for actions and audit registration.
Saves system event metadata and security audits to DynamoDB.
Triggers serverless pipeline execution for file processing.
Invokes Amazon Translate SDK to execute bulk document translations.
